{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm: revenue is string with commas
# Strip commas and convert to float
# Also confirm: no test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print(f'Unique revenue values: {df['revenue'].unique()}')

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders (if any)
completed_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_df['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
